text:
lex: Observed customer reports: deprecation modal causes SDKs to resend which drops x-api-version and routes to v1. Causing quota spikes and noisy billing alerts. Anyone seen this pattern?
sarah: Yep, saw spike at 12:14PT with repeat client_request_id and UA shows older sdk versions. The modal's CTA triggers a reload path in some frontends.
raj: Runtime logs: many requests missing x-api-version but have `X-Client-Retry: true` within 2s of original. We can do three things: edge smoothing, runtime routing heuristic, or console UX change.
dina: Console UX change is fastest. We can change modal CTA from "Retry" to "Continue on v2" (explicit) and make CTA not trigger hard navigation. Also add a tiny copy: "Preserve headers to avoid duplicate billing." I can ship copy + toggle in <30m.
mike: Billing ops: when duplicates hit v1 we get double-counts. We should create a billing-exempt window for deduped retries: if same client_request_id with compat-grace tag, zero-rate the second request. Need runtime to emit a tag.
raj: Proposal: add `X-Compat-Guard: dedupe` when runtime recognizes a likely retry (same client_request_id within 5s). Also, prefer routing to v2 if the SDK UA is new-enough. Pseudoconfig:
```
compat_rules:
  - when:
      missing_header: x-api-version
      recent_retry: true
    action:
      prefer_route: v2
      emit_header: X-Compat-Guard: dedupe
      mark_attribute: billing_exempt_window=5s
      ff: compat_dedupe_v1
```
raj: We'll gate with FF and a canary tenant list.
paul: (cc Paul) Edge rate-limiter: add a token-bucket per-tenant for fallback routing with burst capacity of 50 reqs and refill 10/s to avoid full tenant throttle. That plus dedupe should flatten alerts.
dina: I'll add a per-tenant console toggle under Routing > Deprecations: "Enable safe dedupe routing" with default OFF and a link to FAQs. UI copy to be human-friendly.
lex: For observability, add dashboard widgets: duplicate-retry-rate, compat-guard-inserted, v1-fallback-per-minute. Also log sample bodies for debug. Keep sampling 0.1% for bodies.
mike: Approvals: Billing needs audit hook to reconcile zero-rated events and issue temporary credits if needed. I'll build a quick reporting query.
raj: Risk note: don't change kernel/model or inference path. Only decision path. Add alerts for increased v2 lat tail and 5xx rate.
sarah: Owners and timeline: Dina -> UX copy + toggle in 30m; Raj -> runtime FF and header injection + canary today; Mike -> billing exempt rule + report; Lex -> dashboard tiles. Rollout window afternoon. If anything spikes, rollback FF and revert console toggle.
console-bot: toggle created: deprecation_ui_retry_cta=continue_by_dina at 1765554359
lex: Thanks all — will post a short follow-up with the dashboard links and tenant list for the canary.
